$comment: First-load JS per route, gzipped, in kB (1 000 bytes). scripts/bundle-budget.mjs explains what is counted and why it reads ~1.6 kB above next build's column. EVERY page route is checked: one without an entry here uses `default`, so a new route is never silently unbudgeted — and windows 6 and 13 can add routes to this app without needing to edit a file they do not own. Headroom is ~5 kB: enough for a dependency patch, not enough for a new library to slip in unnoticed. Raise a limit only in the same commit that explains what grew.
